description: Normative statements no conformance vector can express, pinned by a named test in every runtime they apply to. Each runtime's test references the id verbatim; the SDK's consistency check asserts the reference exists. See the conformance suite spec, Harness.

statements.statement: Teardown observed while an action list is executing does not interrupt it: the list runs to completion, and only work arriving afterwards is refused.
On platforms with deterministic lifetimes, deallocation of the view counts as teardown: a completion arriving afterwards is dropped and reported.
The default node count (10,000) and document size (1 MiB) limits hold at their exact boundaries: at the limit builds, one over is LimitExceeded.
